==English==

===Etymology 1===
From {{der|en|fro|frequent}}, from {{der|en|la|frequens||crowded, crammed, frequent, repeated, etc.}}, possibly from a {{der|en|ine-pro|*bʰrekʷ-||to cram together}}.<ref>{{R:itc:EDL|page=242|head='''frequēns'''}}</ref><ref>Schwartzman, The Words of Mathematics: An Etymological Dictionary of Mathematical Terms Used in English</ref>

====Pronunciation====
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfɹiː.kwənt/|a=GenAm,RP}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-frequent-adj.ogg|a=US}}

====Adjective====
{{en-adj|more,er}}

# Done or occurring [[often]]; [[common]].
#: {{syn|en|regular|recurring|usual|Thesaurus:common}}
#: {{ant|en|rare|uncommon|Thesaurus:rare}}
#: {{ux|en|I take '''frequent''' breaks so I don't get too tired.}}
#: {{ux|en|There are '''frequent''' trains to the beach available.}}
#: {{ux|en|I am a '''frequent''' visitor to that city.}}
# Occurring at short intervals.
#: {{syn|en|continual|steady}}
#* {{RQ:Byron Childe Harold|canto=III|stanza=LV.2|page=31|passage=Above, the '''frequent''' feudal towers / Through green leaves lift their walls of grey, [...]}}
# Addicted to any course of conduct; inclined to indulge in any practice; [[habitual]]; [[persistent]].
#* {{RQ:Swift Advancement of Religion|page=59|passage=[E]very Man thinks he has laid in a ſufficient Stock of Merit, and my pretend to any Employment, provided he has been loud and '''frequent''' in declaring himſelf hearty for the Government.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} {{cap|full}}; [[crowded]]; [[thronged]].
#* {{RQ:Jonson Sejanus|passage='Tis Caesar's will to have a '''frequent''' senate.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} Often or commonly reported.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1626|author=w:Philip Massinger|title=w:The Roman Actor
|passage='Tis '''frequent''' in the city he hath subdued / The Catti and the Daci.}}

===Etymology 2===
From {{uder|en|fro|frequenter}}, from {{uder|en|la|frequentare||to fill, crowd, visit often, do or use often, etc.}}, from {{m|la|frequens||frequent, crowded}}.

====Pronunciation====
* {{IPA|en|/fɹɪˈkwɛnt/|a=UK}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛnt|s=2}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-frequent-verb.ogg|a=US}}

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To visit often.
#: {{ux|en|I used to '''frequent''' that restaurant.}}
